class Intervention(int day, real64 multiplier)
class Grid(real64 low, real64 high, int count)
class Scenario(string name, real64 multiplier)
class ContactChange(string name, string group, real64 factor)
class Params(real64 sigma, real64 gamma, real64[] initial, Grid beta_grid, Grid rho_grid, int golden_iterations, int golden_rounds, real64[] simplex, real64[] nm_coefficients, int nm_iterations, int holdout, real64 effect_width, real64 outlier, int death_lag, int[] milestones, int generation, int horizon, real64 threshold, Scenario[] scenarios, ContactChange[] changes)
class Input(int[] cases, int[] deaths, Group[] groups, real64[][] contacts, Intervention[] interventions, Params params)

Params read_parameters()
    rows := [for row := lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    sigma := number(rows[0][1])
    gamma := number(rows[1][1])
    initial := [number(rows[2][1]), number(rows[2][2])]
    beta_grid := Grid(number(rows[3][1]), number(rows[3][2]), integer(rows[3][3]))
    rho_grid := Grid(number(rows[4][1]), number(rows[4][2]), integer(rows[4][3]))
    golden_iterations := integer(rows[5][1])
    golden_rounds := integer(rows[5][2])
    simplex := [number(rows[6][1]), number(rows[6][2])]
    coefficients := [for value := rows[7][1:<5][] then number(value)]
    nm_iterations := integer(rows[7][5])
    holdout := integer(rows[8][1])
    effect_width := number(rows[9][1])
    outlier := number(rows[10][1])
    death_lag := integer(rows[11][1])
    milestones := [for value := rows[12][1:<int(#rows[12])][] then integer(value)]
    generation := integer(rows[13][1])
    horizon := integer(rows[14][1])
    threshold := number(rows[15][1])
    Scenario[] scenarios := []
    ContactChange[] changes := []
    for fields := rows[16:<int(#rows)][]
        if fields[0] == "scenario"
            scenarios = scenarios.append(Scenario(fields[1], number(fields[2])))
        else
            changes = changes.append(ContactChange(fields[1], fields[2], number(fields[3])))
    return Params(sigma, gamma, initial, beta_grid, rho_grid, golden_iterations, golden_rounds, simplex, coefficients, nm_iterations, holdout, effect_width, outlier, death_lag, milestones, generation, horizon, threshold, scenarios, changes)

Input read_inputs()
    int[] cases := []
    int[] deaths := []
    rows := lines("input/cases.csv")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        cases = cases.append(integer(fields[1]))
        deaths = deaths.append(integer(fields[2]))

    for row := lines("input/population.txt")[]

        interventions = interventions.append(Intervention(integer(fields[0]), number(fields[1])))

const real64 phi := 0.6180339887498949

class Golden(real64 point, real64 value, real64[][] records)

Golden golden<T>(func<real64(T, real64)> cost, T context, real64 a, real64 b, int iterations)
    c := b - phi * (b - a)
    d := a + phi * (b - a)
    real64 fc := cost(context, c)
    real64 fd := cost(context, d)
    real64[][] records := [[a, b, c, d, fc, fd]]
    for: i < iterations
        if fc < fd
            b = d
            d = c
            fd = fc
            c = b - phi * (b - a)
            fc = cost(context, c)
        else
            a = c
            c = d
            fc = fd
            d = a + phi * (b - a)
            fd = cost(context, d)
        records = records.append([a, b, c, d, fc, fd])
    return if fc < fd then Golden(c, fc, records) else Golden(d, fd, records)

class Vertex(int serial, real64[] point, real64 value)
class Record(string operation, Vertex best)
class Simplex(Vertex[] initial, Record[] records, Vertex[] vertices)

Vertex[] ordered(Vertex[] vertices)
    Vertex[] result := []
    for vertex := vertices[]
        position := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if vertex.value < result[i].value or (vertex.value == result[i].value and vertex.serial < result[i].serial)
                position = i
                break
        result = result[0:<position].concat([vertex]).concat(result[position:<int(#result)])
    return result

real64[] toward(real64[] origin, real64[] target, real64 factor)
    return [for axis := (0:<2)[] then origin[axis] + factor * (target[axis] - origin[axis])]

Simplex nelder_mead<T>(func<real64(T, real64, real64)> cost, T context, real64 beta, real64 gamma, real64 delta_beta, real64 delta_gamma, real64 alpha, real64 chi, real64 psi, real64 omega, int iterations)
    real64[][] points := [[beta, gamma], [beta + delta_beta, gamma], [beta, gamma + delta_gamma]]
    vertices := [for i := (0:<3)[] then Vertex(i, points[i], cost(context, points[i][0], points[i][1]))]
    initial := vertices
    Record[] records := []
    serial := 3
    for: iteration < iterations
        vertices = ordered(vertices)
        first := vertices[0]
        second := vertices[1]
        third := vertices[2]
        centroid := [for axis := (0:<2)[] then (first.point[axis] + second.point[axis]) / 2.0]
        reflected := [for axis := (0:<2)[] then centroid[axis] + alpha * (centroid[axis] - third.point[axis])]
        real64 fr := cost(context, reflected[0], reflected[1])
        accepted := false
        real64[] point := []
        real64 value := 0.0
        operation := "shrink"
        if fr < first.value
            expanded := toward(centroid, reflected, chi)
            real64 fe := cost(context, expanded[0], expanded[1])
            accepted = true
            if fe < fr
                point = expanded
                value = fe
                operation = "expand"
            else
                point = reflected
                value = fr
                operation = "reflect"
        elif fr < second.value
            accepted = true
            point = reflected
            value = fr
            operation = "reflect"
        elif fr < third.value
            contracted := toward(centroid, reflected, psi)
            real64 fc := cost(context, contracted[0], contracted[1])
            if fc <= fr
                accepted = true
                point = contracted
                value = fc
                operation = "contract_out"
        else
            contracted := toward(centroid, third.point, psi)
            real64 fc := cost(context, contracted[0], contracted[1])
            if fc < third.value
                accepted = true
                point = contracted
                value = fc
                operation = "contract_in"
        if accepted
            vertices = [first, second, Vertex(serial, point, value)]
            serial += 1
        else
            vertices = [first]
            for old := [second, third][]
                shrunk := toward(first.point, old.point, omega)
                vertices = vertices.append(Vertex(serial, shrunk, cost(context, shrunk[0], shrunk[1])))
                serial += 1
        vertices = ordered(vertices)
        records = records.append(Record(operation, vertices[0]))
    return Simplex(initial, records, vertices)

real64[] rk4_step<T>(func<real64[](T, real64[], real64)> rates, T context, real64[] state, real64 multiplier)
    real64 h := 0.25
    half := h / 2.0
    sixth := h / 6.0
    k1 := rates(context, state, multiplier)
    k2_state := [for i := (0:<int(#state))[] then state[i] + half * k1[i]]
    k2 := rates(context, k2_state, multiplier)
    k3_state := [for i := (0:<int(#state))[] then state[i] + half * k2[i]]
    k3 := rates(context, k3_state, multiplier)
    k4_state := [for i := (0:<int(#state))[] then state[i] + h * k3[i]]
    k4 := rates(context, k4_state, multiplier)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#state))[] then state[i] + sixth * (((k1[i] + 2.0 * k2[i]) + 2.0 * k3[i]) + k4[i])]

real64[][] simulate<T>(func<real64[](T, real64[], real64)> rates, T context, real64[] initial, real64[] multipliers, int[] inflows)
    state := initial
    real64[][] daily := []
    for multiplier := multipliers[]
        for index := inflows[]
            state[index] = 0.0
        for: quarter < 4
            state = rk4_step(rates, context, state, multiplier)
        daily = daily.append(state)
    return daily

import math
import data_io = "./data_io.qui"
import models = "./models.qui"
import integrator = "./integrator.qui"
import fitting = "./fitting.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 ordered_sum(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    total := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        total += values[i]
    return total

int integer_sum(int[] values)
    total := 0
    for value := values[]
        total += value
    return total

real64 squared_errors(real64[] series, real64 coefficient, int[] observations)
    real64[] terms := []
    for: i < int(#series)
        difference := coefficient * series[i] - real64(observations[i])
        terms = terms.append(difference * difference)
    return ordered_sum(terms)

int peak(real64[] series)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#series)
        if series[i] > series[result]
            result = i
    return result

string values_text(real64[] values, places := 4)
    return [for value := values[] then report.fmt(value, places)].join(" ")

real64[] multiplier_sequence(data_io.Intervention[] interventions, int days)
    real64[] result := []
    index := 0
    for: 1 <= day <= days
        while index + 1 < int(#interventions) and interventions[index + 1].day <= day
            index += 1
        result = result.append(interventions[index].multiplier)
    return result

real64 final_size(real64 reproduction)
    if reproduction <= 1.0
        return 0.0
    low := 1.0 - 1.0 / reproduction
    real64 high := 1.0
    for: i < 20
        middle := (low + high) / 2.0
        real64 value := 1.0 - middle - math.exp(-reproduction * middle)
        if value > 0.0
            low = middle
        else
            high = middle
    return (low + high) / 2.0

class Eigen(real64 value, real64[] vector)

Eigen power_method(real64[][] matrix)
    size := int(#matrix)
    vector := [for g := (0:<size)[] then 1.0 / real64(size)]
    real64 eigenvalue := 0.0
    for: iteration < 200
        real64[] product := []
        for row := matrix[]
            product = product.append(ordered_sum([for h := (0:<size)[] then row[h] * vector[h]]))
        eigenvalue = ordered_sum(product)
        vector = [for value := product[] then value / eigenvalue]
    return Eigen(eigenvalue, vector)

real64[][] integrate_model(models.Model model, int kind, real64[] initial, real64[] multipliers)
    if kind == 0
        func<real64[](models.Model, real64[], real64)> rates := models.seird
        return integrator.simulate(rates, model, initial, multipliers, [5])
    if kind == 1
        func<real64[](models.Model, real64[], real64)> rates := models.sir
        return integrator.simulate(rates, model, initial, multipliers, [3])
    if kind == 2
        func<real64[](models.Model, real64[], real64)> rates := models.age_seird
        inflows := [for g := (0:<int(#model.populations))[] then 6 * g + 5]
        return integrator.simulate(rates, model, initial, multipliers, inflows)
    func<real64[](models.Model, real64[], real64)> rates := models.generation
    return integrator.simulate(rates, model, initial, multipliers, [2])

class Objective(models.Model model, int kind, int axis, real64 rho, real64[] initial, real64[] multipliers, int[] observations, int first, int last)

real64 cost_one(Objective context, real64 value)
    model := context.model
    rho := context.rho
    multipliers := context.multipliers
    if context.axis == 0
        model.beta = value
    elif context.axis == 1
        model.gamma = value
    elif context.axis == 2
        rho = value
    else
        for: context.first <= i < context.last
            multipliers[i] = value
    states := integrate_model(model, context.kind, context.initial, multipliers)
    column := if context.kind == 1 then 3 else 5
    return squared_errors([for state := states[] then state[column]], rho, context.observations)

real64 cost_two(Objective context, real64 beta, real64 gamma)
    model := context.model
    model.beta = beta
    model.gamma = gamma
    states := integrate_model(model, context.kind, context.initial, context.multipliers)
    return squared_errors([for state := states[] then state[5]], context.rho, context.observations)

class Study(data_io.Input data)
    days := int(#data.cases)
    group_count := int(#data.groups)
    int population := integer_sum([for group := data.groups[] then group.population])
    int case_total := integer_sum(data.cases)
    int death_total := integer_sum(data.deaths)
    real64[] populations := [for group := data.groups[] then real64(group.population)]
    real64[] fatalities := [for group := data.groups[] then group.fatality]
    real64 fatality := ordered_sum([for group := data.groups[] then real64(group.population) * group.fatality]) / real64(population)
    real64 sigma := data.params.sigma
    real64 gamma0 := data.params.gamma
    real64[] initial := [real64(population) - data.params.initial[0] - data.params.initial[1], data.params.initial[0], data.params.initial[1], 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    real64[] sir_initial := [initial[0], data.params.initial[0] + data.params.initial[1], 0.0, 0.0]
    real64[] age_initial := []
    for group_population := populations[]
        local real64 e := data.params.initial[0] * group_population / real64(population)
        local real64 i := data.params.initial[1] * group_population / real64(population)
        age_initial = age_initial.concat([group_population - e - i, e, i, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    real64[] multipliers := multiplier_sequence(data.interventions, days)
    int[][] weeks := [for first := (1:days:7)[] then [first, minimum(first + 6, days)]]
    real64 delta_beta := (data.params.beta_grid.high - data.params.beta_grid.low) / real64(data.params.beta_grid.count - 1)
    real64 delta_rho := (data.params.rho_grid.high - data.params.rho_grid.low) / real64(data.params.rho_grid.count - 1)
    real64 beta_grid := 0.0
    real64 rho_grid := 0.0
    real64 beta_golden := 0.0
    real64 beta := 0.0
    real64 gamma := 0.0
    real64 rho := 0.0
    real64 sse_grid := 0.0
    real64 sse_golden := 0.0
    real64 sse_nm := 0.0
    real64 r0 := 0.0
    real64[][] states := []
    real64[] incidence := []
    real64[] reported := []
    real64[] residuals := []
    real64[] model_deaths := []
    real64[] rt := []
    real64[] averages := []
    int[] cumulative_cases := []
    real64[] cumulative_reported := []
    real64 reported_total := 0.0
    real64[] standard_errors := []
    real64 kbar := 0.0
    real64[][] normalized_contacts := []
    real64[][] age_states := []
    real64[] age_incidence := []
    real64[] empirical_rt := []
    string[] fit_lines := []
    string[] reproduction_lines := []
    string[] age_lines := []
    string[] scenario_rows := []

    real64 rmse(real64 squared_error, count := 0)
        result := math.sqrt(squared_error / real64(if count == 0 then days else count))
        return result

    models.Model config(real64 b, real64 g, real64 s)
        return models.Model(real64(population), s, fatality, b, g, populations, fatalities, normalized_contacts)

    real64[][] seird_states(real64 b, real64 g, real64[] sequence, real64[] start, real64 s)
        return integrate_model(config(b, g, s), 0, start, sequence)

    real64[] incidence_for(real64 b, real64 g)
        return [for state := seird_states(b, g, multipliers, initial, sigma)[] then state[5]]

    real64 sse(real64 b, real64 g, real64 r)
        return squared_errors(incidence_for(b, g), r, data.cases)

    void .golden_records(int round_number, string name, fitting.Golden search)
        for: i < int(#search.records)
            record := search.records[i]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("golden {round_number} {name} {i} a " + report.fmt(record[0], 6) + " b " + report.fmt(record[1], 6) + " c " + report.fmt(record[2], 6) + " d " + report.fmt(record[3], 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(record[4])) + " " + report.fmt(rmse(record[5])))
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("golden_result {round_number} {name} " + report.fmt(search.point, 6) + " sse " + report.fmt(search.value, 1))

    void .fit_model()
        data_io.Grid bgrid := data.params.beta_grid
        data_io.Grid rgrid := data.params.rho_grid
        betas := [for i := (0:<bgrid.count)[] then bgrid.low + (bgrid.high - bgrid.low) * real64(i) / real64(bgrid.count - 1)]
        rhos := [for j := (0:<rgrid.count)[] then rgrid.low + (rgrid.high - rgrid.low) * real64(j) / real64(rgrid.count - 1)]
        fit_lines = ["data days {days} cases {case_total} deaths {death_total} population {population} fatality " + report.fmt(fatality, 6), "grid gamma " + report.fmt(gamma0) + " rho " + values_text(rhos)]
        first := true
        for: i < bgrid.count
            real64[] series := incidence_for(betas[i], gamma0)
            real64[] errors := []
            for: j < rgrid.count
                value := squared_errors(series, rhos[j], data.cases)
                errors = errors.append(value)
                if first or value < sse_grid
                    first = false
                    sse_grid = value
                    beta_grid = betas[i]
                    rho_grid = rhos[j]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("grid beta " + report.fmt(betas[i]) + " rmse " + values_text([for value := errors[] then rmse(value)], 2))
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("grid_best beta " + report.fmt(beta_grid) + " rho " + report.fmt(rho_grid) + " sse " + report.fmt(sse_grid, 1) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(sse_grid)))
        b := beta_grid
        r := rho_grid
        func<real64(Objective, real64)> cost := cost_one
        for: 1 <= int round_number <= data.params.golden_rounds
            beta_context := Objective(config(b, gamma0, sigma), 0, 0, r, initial, multipliers, data.cases, 0, 0)
            beta_search := fitting.golden(cost, beta_context, b - delta_beta, b + delta_beta, data.params.golden_iterations)
            .golden_records(round_number, "beta", beta_search)
            b = beta_search.point
            rho_context := Objective(config(b, gamma0, sigma), 0, 2, r, initial, multipliers, data.cases, 0, 0)
            rho_search := fitting.golden(cost, rho_context, r - delta_rho, r + delta_rho, data.params.golden_iterations)
            .golden_records(round_number, "rho", rho_search)
            r = rho_search.point
            sse_golden = rho_search.value
        beta_golden = b
        rho = r
        context := Objective(config(b, gamma0, sigma), 0, 0, rho, initial, multipliers, data.cases, 0, 0)
        func<real64(Objective, real64, real64)> cost_pair := cost_two
        real64[] coefficients := data.params.nm_coefficients
        result := fitting.nelder_mead(cost_pair, context, b, gamma0, data.params.simplex[0], data.params.simplex[1], coefficients[0], coefficients[1], coefficients[2], coefficients[3], data.params.nm_iterations)
        for vertex := result.initial[]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("simplex {vertex.serial} beta " + report.fmt(vertex.point[0], 6) + " gamma " + report.fmt(vertex.point[1], 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(vertex.value)))
        for: iteration < int(#result.records)
            fitting.Record record := result.records[iteration]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("nelder_mead {iteration + 1} {record.operation} beta " + report.fmt(record.best.point[0], 6) + " gamma " + report.fmt(record.best.point[1], 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(record.best.value)))
        for: rank < 3
            fitting.Vertex vertex := result.vertices[rank]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("final_simplex {rank + 1} beta " + report.fmt(vertex.point[0], 6) + " gamma " + report.fmt(vertex.point[1], 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(vertex.value)))
        beta = result.vertices[0].point[0]
        gamma = result.vertices[0].point[1]
        sse_nm = result.vertices[0].value
        r0 = beta / gamma
        average := real64(case_total) / real64(days)
        sst := ordered_sum([for value := data.cases[] then (real64(value) - average) * (real64(value) - average)])
        fit_lines = fit_lines.concat(["fitted beta " + report.fmt(beta, 6) + " gamma " + report.fmt(gamma, 6) + " rho " + report.fmt(rho, 6) + " sigma " + report.fmt(sigma, 6) + " r0 " + report.fmt(r0), "sse grid " + report.fmt(sse_grid, 1) + " golden " + report.fmt(sse_golden, 1) + " nelder_mead " + report.fmt(sse_nm, 1) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(sse_nm)) + " r2 " + report.fmt(1.0 - sse_nm / sst)])
        names := ["grid", "golden", "nelder_mead"]
        real64[][] stages := [[beta_grid, gamma0, rho_grid, sse_grid], [beta_golden, gamma0, rho, sse_golden], [beta, gamma, rho, sse_nm]]
        for: i < 3
            stage := stages[i]
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("stage {names[i]} beta " + report.fmt(stage[0], 6) + " gamma " + report.fmt(stage[1], 6) + " rho " + report.fmt(stage[2], 6) + " r0 " + report.fmt(stage[0] / stage[1]) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(stage[3])))

    void .death_analysis()
        numerator := ordered_sum([for i := (0:<days)[] then model_deaths[i] * real64(data.deaths[i])])
        denominator := ordered_sum([for value := model_deaths[] then value * value])
        scale := numerator / denominator
        squared_error := squared_errors(model_deaths, 1.0, data.deaths)
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("deaths observed {death_total} model " + report.fmt(states[days][4], 1) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_error)) + " scale " + report.fmt(scale) + " implied_fatality " + report.fmt(fatality * scale, 6) + " cfr " + report.fmt(real64(death_total) / real64(case_total)))
        real64[] correlations := []
        for: int lag <= data.params.death_lag
            a := 0
            b := 0
            y := 0
            for: i < days - lag
                a += data.cases[i] * data.deaths[i + lag]
                b += data.cases[i] * data.cases[i]
                y += data.deaths[i + lag] * data.deaths[i + lag]
            root := math.sqrt(real64(b) * real64(y))
            correlation := real64(a) / root
            correlations = correlations.append(correlation)
            cfr := real64(integer_sum(data.deaths[lag:<days])) / real64(integer_sum(data.cases[0:<days - lag]))
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("death_lag {lag} correlation " + report.fmt(correlation) + " cfr " + report.fmt(cfr))
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("death_best_lag {peak(correlations)}")

    void .fitted_diagnostics()
        states = [initial].concat(seird_states(beta, gamma, multipliers, initial, sigma))
        incidence = [for d := (0:<days)[] then states[d + 1][5]]
        reported = [for value := incidence[] then rho * value]
        residuals = [for d := (0:<days)[] then real64(data.cases[d]) - reported[d]]
        model_deaths = [for d := (0:<days)[] then states[d + 1][4] - states[d][4]]
        rt = [for d := (0:<days)[] then r0 * multipliers[d] * states[d][0] / real64(population)]
        for: d < days
            total := integer_sum(data.cases[maximum(0, d - 6):<d + 1])
            averages = averages.append(real64(total) / real64(minimum(d + 1, 7)))
        observed_total := 0
        for: d < days
            observed_total += data.cases[d]
            reported_total += reported[d]
            cumulative_cases = cumulative_cases.append(observed_total)
            cumulative_reported = cumulative_reported.append(reported_total)
        residual_sum := ordered_sum(residuals)
        magnitudes := [for value := residuals[] then absolute(value)]
        largest := peak(magnitudes)
        positive := 0
        runs := 1
        for: d < days
            if residuals[d] > 0.0
                positive += 1
            if d > 0 and (residuals[d] > 0.0) != (residuals[d - 1] > 0.0)
                runs += 1
        residual_square := ordered_sum([for value := residuals[] then value * value])
        durbin_numerator := ordered_sum([for d := (1:<days)[] then (residuals[d] - residuals[d - 1]) * (residuals[d] - residuals[d - 1])])
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("residuals sum " + report.fmt(residual_sum, 1) + " mae " + report.fmt(ordered_sum(magnitudes) / real64(days), 1) + " max " + report.fmt(residuals[largest], 1) + " day {largest + 1} positive {positive} runs {runs} durbin_watson " + report.fmt(durbin_numerator / residual_square))
        real64[] correlations := []
        for: 1 <= lag <= 7
            correlations = correlations.append(ordered_sum([for d := (0:<days - lag)[] then residuals[d] * residuals[d + lag]]) / residual_square)
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("autocorrelation " + values_text(correlations))
        outliers := 0
        for: d < days
            root := math.sqrt(reported[d])
            z := residuals[d] / root
            if absolute(z) > data.params.outlier
                fit_lines = fit_lines.append("outlier {d + 1} observed {data.cases[d]} fitted " + report.fmt(reported[d], 1) + " z " + report.fmt(z))
                outliers += 1
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("outliers {outliers}")
        real64[] weekday_factors := []
        for: weekday < 7
            observed := 0
            real64[] fitted_terms := []
            for: weekday <= d < days step 7
                observed += data.cases[d]
                fitted_terms = fitted_terms.append(reported[d])
            fitted := ordered_sum(fitted_terms)
            factor := real64(observed) / fitted
            weekday_factors = weekday_factors.append(factor)
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("weekday {weekday + 1} observed {observed} fitted " + report.fmt(fitted, 1) + " factor " + report.fmt(factor))
        adjusted := [for d := (0:<days)[] then reported[d] * weekday_factors[d % 7]]
        infections := ordered_sum(incidence)
        fit_lines = fit_lines.concat(["weekday_adjusted rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_errors(adjusted, 1.0, data.cases))), "burden infections " + report.fmt(infections, 1) + " ascertainment " + report.fmt(real64(case_total) / infections) + " deaths_per_infection " + report.fmt(real64(death_total) / infections, 6)])
        .death_analysis()
        previous_observed := 0
        for: w < int(#weeks)
            first := weeks[w][0]
            last := weeks[w][1]
            observed := integer_sum(data.cases[first - 1:<last])
            fitted := ordered_sum(reported[first - 1:<last])
            dead := integer_sum(data.deaths[first - 1:<last])
            modeled := ordered_sum(model_deaths[first - 1:<last])
            growth := if w == 0 then "-" else report.fmt(real64(observed) / real64(previous_observed))
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("weekly {w + 1} days {first} {last} observed {observed} fitted " + report.fmt(fitted, 1) + " deaths_observed {dead} deaths_model " + report.fmt(modeled, 1) + " growth {growth}")
            previous_observed = observed

    void .profiles()
        fitted := [beta, gamma, rho]
        names := ["beta", "gamma", "rho"]
        variance := sse_nm / real64(days - 3)
        for: parameter < 3
            value := fitted[parameter]
            real64[] errors := []
            for: -5 <= offset <= 5
                point := value * (1.0 + real64(offset) / 100.0)
                parameters := fitted
                parameters[parameter] = point
                real64 squared_error := sse(parameters[0], parameters[1], parameters[2])
                errors = errors.append(squared_error)
                fit_lines = fit_lines.append("profile {names[parameter]} {offset} value " + report.fmt(point, 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_error)))
            h := value / 100.0
            curvature := (errors[6] - 2.0 * errors[5] + errors[4]) / (h * h)
            standard_error := math.sqrt(2.0 * variance / curvature)
            standard_errors = standard_errors.append(standard_error)
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("profile_se {names[parameter]} " + report.fmt(standard_error, 6))

    void .backtest()
        int holdout := data.params.holdout
        training_days := days - holdout
        sequence := multipliers[0:<training_days]
        observations := data.cases[0:<training_days]
        func<real64(Objective, real64)> cost := cost_one
        context := Objective(config(beta, gamma, sigma), 0, 0, rho, initial, sequence, observations, 0, 0)
        beta_search := fitting.golden(cost, context, beta - delta_beta, beta + delta_beta, data.params.golden_iterations)
        context.model.beta = beta_search.point
        context.axis = 2
        rho_search := fitting.golden(cost, context, rho - delta_rho, rho + delta_rho, data.params.golden_iterations)
        real64[][] simulation := seird_states(beta_search.point, gamma, multipliers, initial, sigma)
        forecasts := [for d := (training_days:<days)[] then rho_search.point * simulation[d][5]]
        test_error := squared_errors(forecasts, 1.0, data.cases[training_days:<days])
        full_error := squared_errors(reported[training_days:<days], 1.0, data.cases[training_days:<days])
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("backtest train_days {training_days} beta " + report.fmt(beta_search.point, 6) + " rho " + report.fmt(rho_search.point, 6) + " train_rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(rho_search.value, training_days)) + " test_rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(test_error, holdout)) + " full_fit_test_rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(full_error, holdout)))
        for: i < holdout
            d := training_days + i
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("backtest_day {d + 1} observed {data.cases[d]} forecast " + report.fmt(forecasts[i], 1) + " error " + report.fmt(real64(data.cases[d]) - forecasts[i], 1))

    void .estimate_effects()
        data_io.Intervention[] estimated := data.interventions
        after := sse_nm
        real64 width := data.params.effect_width
        func<real64(Objective, real64)> cost := cost_one
        for: 1 <= k < int(#estimated)
            first := estimated[k].day - 1
            last := if k + 1 < int(#estimated) then estimated[k + 1].day - 1 else days
            context := Objective(config(beta, gamma, sigma), 0, 3, rho, initial, multiplier_sequence(estimated, days), data.cases, first, last)
            real64 given := data.interventions[k].multiplier
            search := fitting.golden(cost, context, given - width, given + width, data.params.golden_iterations)
            estimated[k].multiplier = search.point
            after = search.value
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("effect {k + 1} day {estimated[k].day} given " + report.fmt(given) + " estimated " + report.fmt(search.point, 6) + " sse " + report.fmt(after, 1))
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("effect_sse before " + report.fmt(sse_nm, 1) + " after " + report.fmt(after, 1) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(after)))

    void .sensitivity()
        fitted := [beta, gamma, sigma, rho]
        names := ["beta", "gamma", "sigma", "rho"]
        for: parameter < 4
            for factor := [real64(0.9), real64(1.1)][]
                values := fitted
                values[parameter] *= factor
                real64[][] simulation := seird_states(values[0], values[1], multipliers, initial, values[2])
                series := [for state := simulation[] then state[5]]
                day := peak(series)
                squared_error := squared_errors(series, values[3], data.cases)
                attack := (real64(population) - simulation[days - 1][0]) / real64(population)
                fit_lines = fit_lines.append("sensitivity {names[parameter]} " + report.fmt(factor, 2) + " r0 " + report.fmt(values[0] / values[1]) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_error)) + " peak_day {day + 1} peak " + report.fmt(values[3] * series[day], 1) + " attack " + report.fmt(attack))

    real64[][] age_states_for(real64[][] contacts, real64[] sequence, real64[] start)
        models.Model model := config(beta, gamma, sigma)
        model.contacts = contacts
        return integrate_model(model, 2, start, sequence)

    real64[][] next_generation(real64[][] contacts)
        return [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then [for h := (0:<group_count)[] then r0 * contacts[g][h] * populations[g] / populations[h]]]

    void .analyze_age()
        row_totals := [for row := data.contacts[] then ordered_sum(row)]
        kbar = ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then populations[g] * row_totals[g]]) / real64(population)
        normalized_contacts = [for row := data.contacts[] then [for value := row[] then value / kbar]]
        real64[][] matrix := next_generation(normalized_contacts)
        eigen := power_method(matrix)
        for: g < group_count
            age_lines = age_lines.append("ngm {data.groups[g].name} " + values_text(matrix[g]))
        age_lines = age_lines.append("r0_age " + report.fmt(eigen.value) + " ratio " + report.fmt(eigen.value / r0) + " kbar " + report.fmt(kbar) + " eigenvector " + values_text(eigen.vector))
        real64[] final := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then 1.0]
        for: iteration < 100
            real64[] updated := []
            for: g < group_count
                pressure := ordered_sum([for h := (0:<group_count)[] then r0 * normalized_contacts[g][h] * final[h]])
                updated = updated.append(1.0 - math.exp(-pressure))
            final = updated
        real64[][] long_states := age_states_for(normalized_contacts, [for d := (0:<730)[] then 1.0], age_initial)
        simulated := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then (populations[g] - long_states[729][6 * g]) / populations[g]]
        for: g < group_count
            age_lines = age_lines.append("final_size_age {data.groups[g].name} equation " + report.fmt(final[g]) + " simulated " + report.fmt(simulated[g]))
        final_total := ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then populations[g] * final[g]]) / real64(population)
        simulated_total := ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then populations[g] * simulated[g]]) / real64(population)
        age_lines = age_lines.append("final_size_age total equation " + report.fmt(final_total) + " simulated " + report.fmt(simulated_total))
        age_states = [age_initial].concat(age_states_for(normalized_contacts, multipliers, age_initial))
        age_incidence = [for d := (1:days)[] then ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then age_states[d][6 * g + 5]])]
        for: 0 <= d < days step 7
            previous := age_states[d]
            effective_matrix := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then [for h := (0:<group_count)[] then multipliers[d] * r0 * normalized_contacts[g][h] * previous[6 * g] / populations[h]]]
            effective := power_method(effective_matrix)
            age_lines = age_lines.append("age_rt {d + 1} " + report.fmt(effective.value) + " homogeneous " + report.fmt(rt[d]))
        for: w < int(#weeks)
            first := weeks[w][0]
            last := weeks[w][1]
            totals := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then ordered_sum([for d := (first:last)[] then age_states[d][6 * g + 5]])]
            age_lines = age_lines.append("age_weekly {w + 1} days {first} {last} " + values_text(totals, 1))
        infections := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then ordered_sum([for d := (1:days)[] then age_states[d][6 * g + 5]])]
        infection_total := ordered_sum(infections)
        for: g < group_count
            series := [for d := (1:days)[] then age_states[d][6 * g + 5]]
            day := peak(series)
            attack := (populations[g] - age_states[days][6 * g]) / populations[g]
            deaths := age_states[days][6 * g + 4]
            age_lines = age_lines.append("age {data.groups[g].name} attack " + report.fmt(attack) + " infections " + report.fmt(infections[g], 1) + " share " + report.fmt(infections[g] / infection_total) + " deaths " + report.fmt(deaths, 1) + " peak_day {day + 1} peak " + report.fmt(series[day], 1))
        for change := data.params.changes[]
            target := -1
            for: g < group_count
                if data.groups[g].name == change.group
                    target = g
            real64[] tau := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then (if g == target then change.factor else 1.0)]
            contacts := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then [for h := (0:<group_count)[] then normalized_contacts[g][h] * tau[g] * tau[h]]]
            changed_eigen := power_method(next_generation(contacts))
            real64[][] changed_states := age_states_for(contacts, multipliers, age_initial)
            changed_infections := ordered_sum([for state := changed_states[] then ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then state[6 * g + 5]])])
            deaths := ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then changed_states[days - 1][6 * g + 4]])
            attack := ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then populations[g] - changed_states[days - 1][6 * g]]) / real64(population)
            age_lines = age_lines.append("contact_change {change.name} group {change.group} factor " + report.fmt(change.factor) + " r0_age " + report.fmt(changed_eigen.value) + " infections " + report.fmt(changed_infections, 1) + " deaths " + report.fmt(deaths, 1) + " attack " + report.fmt(attack))

    real64[] sir_incidence(real64 b)
        simulation := integrate_model(config(b, gamma, sigma), 1, sir_initial, multipliers)
        return [for state := simulation[] then state[3]]

    void .compare_models()
        names := ["sir", "seir", "age"]
        real64[][] series := [sir_incidence(beta), incidence, age_incidence]
        for: model_index < 3
            values := series[model_index]
            squared_error := squared_errors(values, rho, data.cases)
            numerator := ordered_sum([for d := (0:<days)[] then real64(data.cases[d]) * values[d]])
            denominator := ordered_sum([for value := values[] then value * value])
            reporting := numerator / denominator
            optimal := squared_errors(values, reporting, data.cases)
            fit_lines = fit_lines.append("model {names[model_index]} rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_error)) + " peak_day {peak(values) + 1} rho_opt " + report.fmt(reporting, 6) + " rmse_opt " + report.fmt(rmse(optimal)))
        context := Objective(config(beta, gamma, sigma), 1, 0, rho, sir_initial, multipliers, data.cases, 0, 0)
        func<real64(Objective, real64)> cost := cost_one
        search := fitting.golden(cost, context, data.params.beta_grid.low, data.params.beta_grid.high, data.params.golden_iterations)
        fit_lines = fit_lines.append("model sir_fit beta " + report.fmt(search.point, 6) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(search.value)) + " peak_day {peak(sir_incidence(search.point)) + 1}")

    void .generation_interval()
        int length := data.params.generation
        simulation := integrate_model(config(beta, gamma, sigma), 3, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [for d := (0:<length)[] then 1.0])
        amounts := [for state := simulation[] then state[2]]
        coverage := ordered_sum(amounts)
        weights := [for value := amounts[] then value / coverage]
        average := ordered_sum([for d := (0:<length)[] then (real64(d + 1) - 0.5) * weights[d]])
        theoretical := 1.0 / sigma + 1.0 / gamma
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("generation mean " + report.fmt(average) + " theory " + report.fmt(theoretical) + " coverage " + report.fmt(coverage))
        for: d < length
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("generation_weight {d + 1} " + report.fmt(weights[d], 6))
        real64[] pressures := []
        for: d < days
            pressures = pressures.append(ordered_sum([for lag := (1:minimum(length, d))[] then weights[lag - 1] * real64(data.cases[d - lag])]))
        for: d < days
            if d + 1 < length + 7
                empirical_rt = empirical_rt.append(-1.0)
            else
                observed := integer_sum(data.cases[d - 6:<d + 1])
                pressure := ordered_sum(pressures[d - 6:<d + 1])
                empirical_rt = empirical_rt.append(real64(observed) / pressure)

    void .epidemic_peaks()
        incidence_day := peak(incidence)
        infectious := [for d := (1:days)[] then states[d][2]]
        infectious_day := peak(infectious)
        observed_day := peak(real64(data.cases))
        average_day := peak(averages)
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.concat(["peak model day {incidence_day + 1} incidence " + report.fmt(incidence[incidence_day], 1) + " reported " + report.fmt(reported[incidence_day], 1) + " infectious_day {infectious_day + 1} infectious " + report.fmt(infectious[infectious_day], 1),
            "peak observed day {observed_day + 1} cases {data.cases[observed_day]} average7_day {average_day + 1} average7 " + report.fmt(averages[average_day], 2)])

    void .periods_and_milestones()
        for: k < int(#data.interventions)
            int first := data.interventions[k].day
            int last := if k + 1 < int(#data.interventions) then data.interventions[k + 1].day - 1 else days
            period_residuals := residuals[first - 1:<last]
            squared_error := ordered_sum([for value := period_residuals[] then value * value])
            count := last - first + 1
            observed := integer_sum(data.cases[first - 1:<last])
            fitted := ordered_sum(reported[first - 1:<last])
            bias := ordered_sum(period_residuals) / real64(count)
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("period {k + 1} days {first} {last} multiplier " + report.fmt(data.interventions[k].multiplier) + " rt_start " + report.fmt(rt[first - 1]) + " rt_end " + report.fmt(rt[last - 1]) + " observed {observed} fitted " + report.fmt(fitted, 1) + " rmse " + report.fmt(rmse(squared_error, count)) + " bias " + report.fmt(bias, 1))
        for target := data.params.milestones[]
            observed := "never"
            fitted := "never"
            for: d < days
                if observed == "never" and cumulative_cases[d] >= target
                    observed = string(d + 1)
                if fitted == "never" and cumulative_reported[d] >= real64(target)
                    fitted = string(d + 1)
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("milestone {target} observed {observed} fitted {fitted}")

    real64[] counterfactual_reported(data_io.Intervention[] interventions)
        sequence := multiplier_sequence(interventions, days)
        real64[][] simulation := seird_states(beta, gamma, sequence, initial, sigma)
        return [for state := simulation[] then rho * state[5]]

    void .counterfactuals()
        real64[] counterfactual := counterfactual_reported(data.interventions[0:<1])
        total := ordered_sum(counterfactual)
        day := peak(counterfactual)
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("counterfactual none reported " + report.fmt(total, 1) + " peak_day {day + 1} peak " + report.fmt(counterfactual[day], 1) + " averted " + report.fmt(total - reported_total, 1))
        for: 1 <= k < int(#data.interventions)
            data_io.Intervention[] changed := data.interventions[0:<k].concat(data.interventions[k + 1:<int(#data.interventions)])
            without := ordered_sum(counterfactual_reported(changed))
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("counterfactual without {k + 1} reported " + report.fmt(without, 1) + " averted " + report.fmt(without - reported_total, 1))
        for: 1 <= k < int(#data.interventions)
            for shift := [-7, 7][]
                data_io.Intervention[] changed := data.interventions
                changed[k].day += shift
                shifted := ordered_sum(counterfactual_reported(changed))
                reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("timing {k + 1} shift {shift} reported " + report.fmt(shifted, 1) + " change " + report.fmt(shifted - reported_total, 1))

    void .analyze_reproduction()
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("r0 " + report.fmt(r0) + " herd_immunity " + report.fmt(1.0 - 1.0 / r0))
        real64[][] long_states := seird_states(beta, gamma, [for d := (0:<730)[] then 1.0], initial, sigma)
        attack := (real64(population) - long_states[729][0]) / real64(population)
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("final_size equation " + report.fmt(final_size(r0)) + " simulated " + report.fmt(attack))
        .generation_interval()
        .epidemic_peaks()
        .periods_and_milestones()
        .counterfactuals()
        for: 1 <= d < days
            if (rt[d] < 1.0) != (rt[d - 1] < 1.0)
                direction := if rt[d] < 1.0 then "down" else "up"
                reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("rt_cross day {d + 1} {direction}")
        for: d < days
            empirical := if empirical_rt[d] < 0.0 then "-" else report.fmt(empirical_rt[d])
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("rt {d + 1} model " + report.fmt(rt[d]) + " empirical {empirical}")
        reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.concat(age_lines)

    void .scenario_projections()
        int horizon := data.params.horizon
        scenario_rows = ["scenario,day,incidence,reported"]
        real64 first_total := 0.0
        for: index < int(#data.params.scenarios)
            data_io.Scenario scenario := data.params.scenarios[index]
            future := [for d := (0:<horizon)[] then scenario.multiplier]
            real64[][] projection := seird_states(beta, gamma, future, states[days], sigma)
            predictions := [for state := projection[] then rho * state[5]]
            total := ordered_sum(predictions)
            if index == 0
                first_total = total
            peak_index := peak(predictions)
            attack := (real64(population) - projection[horizon - 1][0]) / real64(population)
            effective := r0 * scenario.multiplier * states[days][0] / real64(population)
            below := "never"
            above := 0
            for: d < horizon
                if predictions[d] < data.params.threshold and below == "never"
                    below = string(days + d + 1)
                if predictions[d] >= data.params.threshold
                    above += 1
                scenario_rows = scenario_rows.append("{scenario.name},{days + d + 1}," + report.fmt(projection[d][5], 1) + "," + report.fmt(predictions[d], 1))
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("scenario {scenario.name} multiplier " + report.fmt(scenario.multiplier) + " rt " + report.fmt(effective) + " reported " + report.fmt(total, 1) + " peak_day {days + peak_index + 1} peak " + report.fmt(predictions[peak_index], 1) + " attack " + report.fmt(attack) + " final_size " + report.fmt(final_size(r0 * scenario.multiplier)) + " averted " + report.fmt(first_total - total, 1) + " below {below} days_above {above}")
            bounds := [beta - 2.0 * standard_errors[0], beta + 2.0 * standard_errors[0]]
            real64[] totals := []
            for bound := bounds[]
                real64[][] simulation := seird_states(bound, gamma, multipliers.concat(future), initial, sigma)
                totals = totals.append(ordered_sum([for d := (days:<(days + horizon))[] then rho * simulation[d][5]]))
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("scenario_band {scenario.name} beta_low " + report.fmt(bounds[0], 6) + " reported_low " + report.fmt(totals[0], 1) + " beta_high " + report.fmt(bounds[1], 6) + " reported_high " + report.fmt(totals[1], 1))
            real64[][] age_projection := age_states_for(normalized_contacts, future, age_states[days])
            final_state := age_projection[horizon - 1]
            attacks := [for g := (0:<group_count)[] then (populations[g] - final_state[6 * g]) / populations[g]]
            deaths := ordered_sum([for g := (0:<group_count)[] then final_state[6 * g + 4]])
            reproduction_lines = reproduction_lines.append("scenario_age {scenario.name} attack " + values_text(attacks) + " deaths " + report.fmt(deaths, 1))

    string[] trajectories()
        rows := ["day,S,E,I,R,D,incidence,reported,observed,average7,cumulative_observed,cumulative_reported"]
        for: d < days
            values := [string(d + 1)]
            values = values.concat([for value := states[d + 1][] then report.fmt(value, 1)])
            values = values.concat([report.fmt(reported[d], 1), string(data.cases[d]), report.fmt(averages[d], 2), string(cumulative_cases[d]), report.fmt(cumulative_reported[d], 1)])
            rows = rows.append(values.join(","))
        return rows

void run()
    data := data_io.read_inputs()
    study := Study(data)
    .study.fit_model()
    .study.fitted_diagnostics()
    .study.profiles()
    .study.backtest()
    .study.estimate_effects()
    .study.sensitivity()
    .study.analyze_age()
    .study.compare_models()
    .study.analyze_reproduction()
    .study.scenario_projections()
    data_io.write("fit.txt", study.fit_lines)
    data_io.write("trajectories.csv", study.trajectories())
    data_io.write("scenarios.csv", study.scenario_rows)
    data_io.write("reproduction.txt", study.reproduction_lines)
    data_io.write("curve_plot.txt", report.curve_plot(data.cases, study.reported))

run()

class Model(real64 population, real64 sigma, real64 fatality, real64 beta, real64 gamma, real64[] populations, real64[] fatalities, real64[][] contacts)

real64[] seird(Model model, real64[] state, real64 multiplier)
    susceptible := state[0]
    exposed := state[1]
    infectious := state[2]
    flow := model.beta * multiplier * susceptible * infectious / model.population
    progression := model.sigma * exposed
    removal := model.gamma * infectious
    return [-flow, flow - progression, progression - removal, (1.0 - model.fatality) * model.gamma * infectious, model.fatality * model.gamma * infectious, progression]

real64[] sir(Model model, real64[] state, real64 multiplier)
    flow := model.beta * multiplier * state[0] * state[1] / model.population
    removal := model.gamma * state[1]
    return [-flow, flow - removal, removal, flow]

real64[] age_seird(Model model, real64[] state, real64 multiplier)
    real64[] result := []
    for: g < int(#model.populations)
        first := 6 * g
        susceptible := state[first]
        exposed := state[first + 1]
        infectious := state[first + 2]
        real64 pressure := 0.0
        for: h < int(#model.populations)
            term := model.contacts[g][h] * state[6 * h + 2] / model.populations[h]
            pressure += term
        force := model.beta * multiplier * pressure
        flow := force * susceptible
        progression := model.sigma * exposed
        removal := model.gamma * infectious
        result = result.concat([-flow, flow - progression, progression - removal, (1.0 - model.fatalities[g]) * model.gamma * infectious, model.fatalities[g] * model.gamma * infectious, progression])
    return result

real64[] generation(Model model, real64[] state, real64 multiplier)
    progression := model.sigma * state[0]
    removal := model.gamma * state[1]
    return [-progression, progression - removal, removal]

import math

string fmt(real64 value, places := 4)
    factor := 10 ^ places
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(magnitude * real64(factor) + 0.5)
    tail := string(rounded % factor)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and rounded != 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign + string(rounded / factor) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

string[] curve_plot(int[] observed, real64[] fitted)
    days := int(#observed)
    maximum := observed[0]
    for value := observed[]
        if value > maximum
            maximum = value
    width := int(#string(maximum))
    grid := [for row := (0:<20)[] then [for column := (0:<70)[] then "."]]
    for: column < 70
        day := column * (days - 1) / 69
        observed_row := 20 * observed[day] / maximum
        if observed_row > 19
            observed_row = 19
        fitted_row := math.floor(20.0 * fitted[day] / real64(maximum))
        if fitted_row > 19
            fitted_row = 19
        grid[observed_row][column] = "o"
        grid[fitted_row][column] = if observed_row == fitted_row then "#" else "*"
    lines := ["plot observed o fitted * both # days 1 {days} max {maximum}"]
    row := 19
    while row >= 0
        label := string(maximum * row / 20)
        lines = lines.append(" " * nat(width - int(#label)) + label + " |" + grid[row].join(""))
        row -= 1
    ticks := [for column := (0:<70)[] then (if column % 10 == 0 then "+" else "-")].join("")
    lines = lines.append(" " * nat(width + 1) + "+" + ticks)
    labels := [for column := (0:<70)[] then " "]
    for: 0 <= column < 70 step 10
        label := string(1 + column * (days - 1) / 69)
        for: offset < int(#label)
            labels[column + offset] = label[offset]
    while #labels > 0 and labels[-1] == " "
        labels = labels[0:<int(#labels) - 1]
    return lines.append(" " * nat(width + 2) + labels.join(""))
